_comment: The conversation manager host's declared data (V2-941): the shape of the model's orders and claims, what a model call's measurements carry, the reads a switched session offers, the counters of its proof, and the lines of its prefix. Names and schemas, no word of a language — data the code reads, never a table in it.

web_search.about: the world now: news, prices, weather, sports, places, facts

read_widget.about: one of his widgets (agenda, contacts, notes…): what it holds now

recall.about: his memory: what he told you before

about_self.about: yourself: what you are, what you can do, how something of yours works

stop_rule: a stop first, before any read, and only when his words ask to stop, silence or cancel something; handing you something, or the word in another sense, is no stop

stops.stop_voice: he asks you to be quiet: your voice stops; reply only if he asked something besides stopping
stops.stop_media: he asks to stop what is playing: it stops, nothing else
stops.stop_run: he asks you to stop or cancel what you are doing: your voice stops, this answer is dropped
stops.stop_all: he asks to stop everything: your voice, what plays, his errands
